{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter to completed orders only
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
valid_completed_df = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = valid_completed_df['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output result
print(f"Number of completed orders: {len(completed_df)}")
print(f"Number of QA orders removed: {len(completed_df) - len(valid_completed_df)}")
print(f"Mean revenue of valid completed orders: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
